title: cairn codemother retire checks the callers of what it deletes, in the same act
intention: cairn codemother retire <path>... deletes code only after measuring, in the same act, that nothing calls it: it runs the proofs of the files that name each target, restores every target and names the caller when one reds, and reports what it could not measure. Nothing checks afterwards.
why: Outline 1.3.7.1.1, Akien 2026-11-17: a retirement checks its callers in the same act as the deletion, and nothing checks afterwards; he chose a command over a per-verdict check (option a). Measured the same day: bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py keeps eight retirements' worth of stays-gone teeth, and its one red (be4c6edef91b) is a measured fixture that only names a retired path.
traces_to: Law 4 (outline 1.3.7.1.1 enforced by a command, not by habit); Law 5 (a standing proof that a thing stays gone is history kept as code).
how: retire.py in a new codemother machine: namers(repo, targets), proofs_for(repo, namers), retire(repo, targets, runner) moves the targets to a temp folder, runs the proofs, moves them back on any red. cairn/devices/codemother/bin/retire is 'cairn codemother retire'. First use: run it on bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py and bin/validations/test_retired_components_are_gone.json, expect the refusal naming test_every_built_probe_spec_names_a_file.py, repoint its _PRESENT and the three comments, run it again; then be4c6edef91b crosses RETIRED.

clauses.claim: over a scratch git repo, a target whose namers' proofs stay green is deleted, and the report names the namers, the proofs run and the namers not run
a target one of whose namers' proofs reds is restored byte for byte, the exit is 1, and the red proof is named as the caller
a code namer with no proof beside it is reported as unmeasured, and history.json, state.json, validations/ and dot-files are never namers
cairn codemother retire with no target exits 2 and prints its usage

decisions.text: D1: retire.py. namers: repo files (os.walk; skip dot-dirs, __pycache__, *.egg-info, validations/, history.json, state.json, verdict-*.json and the targets themselves) whose text holds a target's repo path, or for a .py file or a folder under cairn/ or skills/ its dotted module. proofs_for: namers matching */proofs/test_*.py, plus for a code namer (.py, .sh, or a file under a bin/) every proofs/test_*.py of the nearest ancestor holding intention+why.json; a code namer with neither is unmeasured; prose and json namers are not run. retire(repo, targets, runner=None): refuse a missing target; move each into a TemporaryDirectory; runner(repo, proofs) -> {path: 'green'|'red'} (default bin/cairn test <proofs>, parsing '^\s+(green|red)\s+(\S+)$'); any red or a proof the runner did not report moves every target back; exit 0 retired, 1 restored, 2 usage. It never commits.

D2: cairn/devices/codemother/bin/retire, the shape of cairn/devices/codemother/bin/outline, so the verb is 'cairn codemother retire <path>...'. Outline 1.3.7.1.1 gains a child line naming the command.
D3: the proof, one tooth per clause, over a scratch git repo with the runner injected (each fixture proof is a two-line python file that exits 0 or 1, run by a runner that runs it with python3).

D4: first use. Run retire on the proof and its validation and record the refusal; repoint _PRESENT in the probe-spec proof to bin/cairn and rewrite the three comments to say the retirement was checked when deleted (outline 1.3.7.1.1); run retire again; be4c6edef91b crosses RETIRED.

out: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_network_seal_is_retired.py and any other standing stays-gone proof

measured.saw: bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py carries eight retirement tickets' teeth; its red tooth nothing_names_ruling is hit only by a fixture list in cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow_anchors_before_the_build_that_stands.py; four files name the proof, one as a sample present path
measured.how: running the proof under bin/cairn test; grep -rln over the repo

orient.intent: A new codemother machine and shortcut make outline 1.3.7.1.1 a command: list a target's namers, move the target aside, run the namers' proofs (and the proofs of components whose code names it), move it back on any red naming the caller, report namers it could not measure. First use retires the standing stays-gone proof and its validation.
orient.scope: IN: the retire machine (retire.py, charter, proof), codemother's bin/retire, a child line under 1.3.7.1.1, the first use (the old proof, its validation, the four namers it touches). OUT: other standing stays-gone proofs, committing inside the command, every other component.
